purpose: Teach: 聖なる/僧侶/悲観/電化/断食/途方/悪徳/投影

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、聖なる儀礼の人類学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you worked on the anthropology of sacred rituals for your paper, didn't you.
lines.style: Steady, curious opening. Warm tone — genuinely interested in his work. Slow, measured pace. Eyes engaged, leaning in slightly to hear his response.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、中世の僧侶教育を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I researched medieval monastic education.
lines.style: Modest, a bit nervous. Quick breath before speaking. Focuses on the facts, not overselling. Slight pause, as if checking whether he's answered thoroughly enough.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、悲観的展望と楽観的展望の比較研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you compared pessimistic and optimistic outlooks in your research, is that right.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before the question. Gentle tone — not testing him, genuinely reflecting. Slow delivery. Eyes warm and patient, waiting for the real answer.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、地方鉄道の電化史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I studied the electrification history of local railways.
lines.style: Quiet, matter-of-fact. No apology in the tone but a kind of precision. Short breath. Straightforward without defensiveness.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 宗教的断食の効能研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You researched the effects of religious fasting, then.
lines.style: Engaged and present. Steady tone, genuine interest. Leans forward slightly. Pace is conversational but unhurried — making space for his answer.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、孤独で途方に暮れる若者の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I researched young people struggling with loneliness and uncertainty.
lines.style: Sincere and grounded. Slight softness in the delivery despite the heavy topic. Eyes steady. Pause before speaking, as if the subject matters to him.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、近世の悪徳商人の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you focused on corrupt merchants in the early modern period, correct.
lines.style: Reflective, thoughtful opening. Calm tone. Eyes watching him carefully — reading his response. Slow, deliberate pace.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、影絵の投影技術史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I studied the technical history of shadow puppet projection.
lines.style: Direct and steady to the final word. Quiet completion — not trailing off. Eyes meet hers. A kind of quiet certainty in the delivery.
